diagnosis: ExportDownloadView uses TimestampSigner to validate download requests. While the signature verifies integrity of export_job_id, the view never validates whether the user making the GET request is authenticated and matches job.creator (or belongs to the same tenant organization). If an export link is leaked or logged in proxy access logs, any unauthorized third party can download proprietary customer export archives.
